label: FortiSwitch 148F 48-port rack switch, 4x 10G SFP+
description: Fortinet FortiSwitch 148F 1 RU Layer 2 switch: 48x GE RJ45, 4x 1/10G SFP+ uplinks, 176 Gbps switching capacity, 260 Mpps. No PoE.

fabric.note: Datasheet switching capacity 176 Gbps duplex with 260 Mpps: 48x 1G plus 4x 10G is 88 Gbit/s of line rate, doubled to 176 Gbps full duplex.

notes: Datasheet: 48x GE RJ45 and 4x 10GE SFP+; 0 PoE ports, 0 W budget; 176 Gbps switching capacity, 260 Mpps, 32 K MAC, <1 us latency, 4 K VLANs, 2 MB packet buffer, 512 MB DDR3, 64 MB flash, >10 years MTBF. 44 x 260 x 440 mm, 3.46 kg, 55.8 W average / 57 W maximum. Ports 1-48 are RJ45 and 49-52 the SFP+ cages; FortiLink runs on ports 45-52, the last four copper ports plus the four cages, and the cages also take 1G SFP optics (148F QuickStart Guide). No dedicated management port; rear PSU 100-240 V AC, 1.5 A max. Console is the RJ-45 serial port at 115200 8-N-1 by default (https://docs.fortinet.com/document/fortiswitch/7.6.5/enterprise-data-center-switching-with-evpn-vxlan-deployment-guide/313313/deployment-procedures), console IP 192.168.1.99. Layer 2 only - the FortiGate routes over FortiLink, so no l3-forward.
